faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for the current recruitment drive by Punjab Agricultural University is Young Professional-1. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Young Professional-1?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Young Professional-1 post in the Punjab Agricultural University Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for PAU Young Professional-1?
faq.answer: The last date for submission and receipt of the application form for the Young Professional-1 post is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Young Professional-1?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B. Tech. (Agricultural Engineering) or M.Tech in Farm Machinery & Power Engineering, along with Punjabi knowledge up to Matric Level.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-1 position?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Young Professional-1 post must be between 21 and 45 years of age. No age relaxation details are specified.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Young Professional-1 at PAU?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for Young Professional-1 will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for PAU Young Professional-1 Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 200/-, payable as a Bank Draft in favor of Comptroller, PAU, Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Young Professional-1 post at Punjab Agricultural University is offline. Candidates need to send the form by post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Young Professional-1?
faq.answer: The selection process involves verification of documents on 27 August 2026 at 11:00 a.m. in the office of the undersigned.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for the Young Professional-1 post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Young Professional-1 position is Ludhiana, Punjab, at the Punjab Agricultural University campus.
